_doc: Optional MCP servers. Enable with `bin/stack mcp enable <name>` (copies the entry into .mcp.json and settings approvals); disable with `bin/stack mcp disable <name>`. OAuth servers authenticate via /mcp inside Claude Code.

fal._note: fal's hosted MCP (~60 tools: search_models, run_model, submit_jobs, create_entity for reusable characters/styles from 1-20 refs). Key-header auth accepted for initialize/tools/list on probe; the documented route is OAuth via https://mcp.fal.ai/mcp-relay. Cannot read local paths (use upload_file).

replicate._note: official local Replicate MCP; reads REPLICATE_API_TOKEN

recraft._note: official remote Recraft MCP (OAuth, subscription credits): generate_image incl. _vector models, vectorize_image, remove_background, crisp_upscale

flux._note: official Black Forest Labs MCP (OAuth): FLUX.2 generate/variations

peekaboo._note: open-source macOS computer use (accessibility-tree first). Needs Screen Recording + Accessibility for the app running Claude Code. Use when the built-in computer-use server is unavailable (e.g. headless/-p runs).

markitdown._note: Microsoft markitdown: convert_to_markdown(uri) for PDFs/Office/HTML, run with uvx on Python 3.14
